data.name: F.R.A.X: BLACKOUT
data.detailed_description:
"He sees himself at a witches' sabbath, among monsters, sorcerers, and the dead…"

The world is dying. The hard part is living through it.

Explore a city overrun by the infected, manage resources, and build relationships with a cast of survivors as your choices shape how your story unfolds.

F.R.A.X is a highly experimental project, that attempts at blending open-world exploration, horror and illustrated story presentation in a way never seen before: The grit and despair of survival, and the depth of a rich story with a memorable cast.

Features:

Character Customization – Create your survivor and immerse yourself in a story that is truly your own.

Open-World Exploration – Explore an infected-overrun Tokyo, entering homes, stores, police stations, and many other buildings. Every place with its own story, its own secrets.

Explore, Fight & Survive – Search for supplies, manage your inventory, equip armor, and fight the infected with melee and ranged combat: blunt and bladed melee weapons, Pistols and Assault Rifles. Shoot, break bones, and cut off limbs.

Go out alone, or with your group members.

Simple Crafting – Scavenge, combine, survive.

Story-Driven Gameplay – Immerse yourself in the world, explore personal stories, interact with a charming cast, make decisions, and shape how your group sees you.

Who will survive?

Illustrated Storytelling – Experience the story through drawn cinematic event CGs, expressive character portraits, and immersive text-driven sequences inspired by the format and presentation of Visual Novels.

Expect richly written dialogue, introspective narration, and slow-burn character development woven into the day-to-day of the end of the world.

Leveling & Progression – The dead grow stronger each day. So must you.

Your survivor grows by taking risks: killing infected, scavenging, and staying on the move. Every day that passes makes the infected tougher, forcing you to adapt or die. Damage multipliers increase as you level, but the infected grow more resilient with time. There's no safety in standing still; it will only get you overwhelmed. Push forward, burn through resources and fight to stay one step ahead. In BLACKOUT, the world doesn’t wait for you.

It consumes the unprepared.

Nightmare Mode - Features a Hardcore difficulty setting, with permanent death and a much harsher progression meant for skilled survivors.

data.short_description: FRAX: BLACKOUT is an open-world zombie survival game with Visual Novel-style storytelling. Half exploration, half immersion in a deep story set in a falling Tokyo. Brutal combat, limited bullets, and a charming cast wrapped in a gritty anime aesthetic.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7400 CPU @ 3.00GHz, 3001 Mhz, 4 Core(s), 4 Logical Processor(s)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: FRAX: BLACKOUT is a mature game with mature themes and potentially disturbing visuals. It is not recommended to those under the age of 18.
